translations.idiomatic: Duo'erzhiban had long had wind illness. In the army, affected by mist and dew, his ailment grew worse, and he died at the Lanxi post station in Huang Prefecture at the age of forty.

sentences.zh: 朵尔直班立朝，以扶持名教为己任，荐拔人才而不以为私恩。

translations.literal: When Duo'erzhiban stood at court he took upholding the name and teaching as his own task, recommended and advanced talented men, and did not regard it as private favor.
translations.idiomatic: At court Duo'erzhiban took upholding the name and teaching as his task, recommended talented men, and did not regard it as private favor.

sentences.zh: 留心经术，凡伊、洛诸儒之书，未尝去手。

translations.literal: He devoted attention to classical learning; books of the Yi and Luo Confucians never left his hand.
translations.idiomatic: He devoted attention to classical learning; books of the Yi and Luo Confucians never left his hand.

sentences.zh: 喜为五言诗，于字画尤精。

translations.literal: He delighted in writing five-character poetry and was especially skilled in calligraphy and painting.
translations.idiomatic: He delighted in writing five-character poetry and was especially skilled in calligraphy and painting.

sentences.zh: 翰林学士承旨临川危素，尝客于朵尔直班，谏之曰：「明公之学，当务安国家、利让稷，毋为留神于末艺。」

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and drafting academician Wei Su of Linchuan once lodged with Duo'erzhiban and remonstrated: "The learning of the illustrious gentleman ought to devote itself to securing the state and benefiting the altars of soil and grain; do not fix the mind on minor arts."
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin drafting academician Wei Su of Linchuan once lodged with Duo'erzhiban and remonstrated, "Your learning ought to devote itself to securing the state and benefiting the altars of soil and grain; do not fix your mind on minor arts."

sentences.zh: 朵尔直班深服其言。

translations.literal: Duo'erzhiban deeply accepted his words.
translations.idiomatic: Duo'erzhiban deeply accepted his words.

sentences.zh: 其在经筵，开陈大义为多。

translations.literal: At the Classics Colloquium he opened and set forth the great principles in the majority of cases.
translations.idiomatic: At the Classics Colloquium he opened and set forth the great principles in the majority of cases.

sentences.zh: 间采前贤遗言，各以类次，为书凡四卷，一曰《学本》，二曰《君道》，三曰《臣职》，四曰《国政》。

translations.literal: Occasionally he gathered the legacy words of former worthies, arranged each by category, and made a book in four scrolls: the first called 《Foundations of Learning》, the second 《The Way of the Ruler》, the third 《The Duties of Ministers》, the fourth 《National Government》.
translations.idiomatic: Occasionally he gathered legacy words of former worthies, arranged each by category, and made a book in four scrolls: the first 《Foundations of Learning》, the second 《The Way of the Ruler》, the third 《The Duties of Ministers》, the fourth 《National Government》.

sentences.zh: 明道、厚伦、制行、稽古、游艺，五者《学本》之目也；

translations.literal: Illuminating the Way, thickening human relations, regulating conduct, examining antiquity, and recreative arts—these five are the categories of 《Foundations of Learning》;
translations.idiomatic: Illuminating the Way, thickening human relations, regulating conduct, examining antiquity, and recreative arts—these five are the categories of 《Foundations of Learning》;

sentences.zh: 敬天、爱民、知人、纳谏、治内，五者《君道》之目也；

translations.literal: revering Heaven, loving the people, knowing men, accepting remonstrance, and governing the interior—these five are the categories of 《The Way of the Ruler》;
translations.idiomatic: revering Heaven, loving the people, knowing men, accepting remonstrance, and governing the interior—these five are the categories of 《The Way of the Ruler》;

sentences.zh: 宰辅、台察、守令、将帅、御，五者《臣职》之目也；

translations.literal: chief ministers, the censorate, prefects and magistrates, commanders, and the imperial guard—these five are the categories of 《The Duties of Ministers》;
translations.idiomatic: chief ministers, the censorate, prefects and magistrates, commanders, and the imperial guard—these five are the categories of 《The Duties of Ministers》;

sentences.zh: 兴学、训农、理财、审刑、议兵，五者《国政》之目也。

translations.literal: promoting learning, instructing agriculture, managing finances, reviewing punishments, and deliberating on troops—these five are the categories of 《National Government》.
translations.idiomatic: promoting learning, instructing agriculture, managing finances, reviewing punishments, and deliberating on troops—these five are the categories of 《National Government》.

sentences.zh: 帝览而善之，赐名曰《治原通训》，藏于宣文阁。

translations.literal: The emperor read it and approved, bestowing the name 《Comprehensive Instructions for Ordering the Source》 and storing it in the Hall of Promoting Culture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read it and approved, bestowing the name 《Comprehensive Instructions for Ordering the Source》 and storing it in the Hall of Promoting Culture.

sentences.zh: 二子：铁固思帖木而、笃坚帖木而。

translations.literal: He had two sons: Tiegusitiemuer and Dujiantiemuer.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: Tiegusitiemuer and Dujiantiemuer.

sentences.zh: 阿鲁图

translations.literal: Alutu
translations.idiomatic: Alutu

sentences.zh: 阿鲁图，博尔术四世孙。

translations.literal: Alutu was a fourth-generation descendant of Borokhula.
translations.idiomatic: Alutu was a fourth-generation descendant of Borokhula.

sentences.zh: 父木剌忽。

translations.literal: His father was Malahu.
translations.idiomatic: His father was Malahu.

sentences.zh: 阿鲁图由经正监袭职为怯薛官，掌环卫，遂拜翰林学士承旨，迁知枢密院事。

translations.literal: Alutu by the Directorate of the Classics succeeded to office as a kheshig officer in charge of the imperial guard, was then appointed Hanlin academician and drafting academician, and was transferred to know the affairs of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Alutu succeeded through the Directorate of the Classics to office as a kheshig officer in charge of the imperial guard, was appointed Hanlin drafting academician, and was transferred to know the affairs of the privy council.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，袭封广平王。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan he succeeded to the enfeoffment as Prince of Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhiyuan he succeeded to the enfeoffment as Prince of Guangping.

sentences.zh: 至正四年，脱脱辞相位，顺帝问谁可代脱脱为相者，脱脱以阿鲁图荐。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhizheng, when Toghto resigned the chancellorship, Emperor Shundi asked who could replace Toghto as chief minister; Toghto recommended Alutu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhizheng, when Toghto resigned the chancellorship, Emperor Shundi asked who could replace him; Toghto recommended Alutu.

sentences.zh: 五月，诏拜中书右丞相、监修国史，而别兒怯不花为左丞相，从驾行幸，每同车出入，一时朝野以二相协和为喜。

translations.literal: In the fifth month an edict appointed him right chief councilor of the Secretariat and supervisor of the compilation of the national history, while Bieqiebuha was left chief councilor. They accompanied the imperial procession on tours and each time entered and left in the same carriage; for a time court and country rejoiced that the two chief ministers were in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month an edict appointed him right chief councilor of the Secretariat and supervisor of the national history, while Bieqiebuha was left chief councilor. They accompanied the imperial procession and each time rode in the same carriage; court and country rejoiced that the two chief ministers were in harmony.

sentences.zh: 时诏修辽、金、宋三史，阿鲁图为总裁。

translations.literal: At that time an edict ordered the compilation of the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song; Alutu was chief compiler.
translations.idiomatic: At that time an edict ordered the compilation of the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song; Alutu was chief compiler.

sentences.zh: 五年，三史成。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the three histories were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the three histories were completed.

sentences.zh: 十月，阿鲁图等既以其书进，帝御宣文阁，阿鲁图复与平章政事帖木兒塔识、太平上奏：「太祖取金，世祖平宋，混一区宇，典章图籍皆归秘府。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, after Alutu and the rest had presented the books, the emperor proceeded to the Hall of Promoting Culture. Alutu again together with Pacification Commissioner Temiertashi and Taiping submitted: "Taizu took the Jin, Shizu pacified the Song, and united the realm; canonical books and maps all returned to the secret repository.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, after Alutu and the rest had presented the books, the emperor proceeded to the Hall of Promoting Culture. Alutu again with Pacification Commissioner Temiertashi and Taiping submitted, "Taizu took the Jin, Shizu pacified the Song, and united the realm; canonical books and maps all returned to the secret repository.

sentences.zh: 今陛下以三国事绩命儒士纂修，而臣阿鲁图总裁。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty has ordered Confucian scholars to compile the achievements of the three states, and your subject Alutu is chief compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty has ordered Confucian scholars to compile the achievements of the three states, and your subject Alutu is chief compiler.

sentences.zh: 臣素不读汉人文书，未解其义。

translations.literal: Your subject has never read Han people's literary works and does not understand their meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has never read Han literary works and does not understand their meaning.

sentences.zh: 今者进呈，万机之暇，乞以备乙览。」

translations.literal: Now that we present them, in the leisure of ten thousand affairs we beg that they may be prepared for secondary perusal."
translations.idiomatic: Now that we present them, in the leisure of ten thousand affairs we beg that they may be prepared for secondary perusal."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此事卿诚未解，史书所系甚重，非儒士泛作文字也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In this matter you indeed do not understand. Histories bear on matters of great weight—they are not literary works casually made by Confucian scholars.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "In this matter you indeed do not understand. Histories bear on matters of great weight—they are not literary works casually made by Confucian scholars.

sentences.zh: 彼一国人君行善则国兴，朕为君者宜取以为法；

translations.literal: When a ruler of one of those states did good, the state flourished—a ruler like Us ought to take it as a model;
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler of one of those states did good, the state flourished—a ruler like Us ought to take it as a model;

sentences.zh: 彼一朝行恶则国废，朕当取以为戒。

translations.literal: when one court did evil, the state was ruined—We ought to take it as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: when one court did evil, the state was ruined—We ought to take it as a warning.

sentences.zh: 然岂止儆劝人君，其间亦有为宰相事，善则卿等宜仿效，恶则宜监戒。

translations.literal: Yet it is not only to warn and encourage rulers; among them are also matters of chief ministers—what is good the likes of you ought to imitate, what is evil you ought to watch and warn against.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it is not only to warn rulers; among them are also matters of chief ministers—what is good you ought to imitate, what is evil you ought to watch and warn against.

sentences.zh: 朕与卿等皆当取前代善恶为勉。

translations.literal: We and the likes of you should all take the good and evil of former ages as encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: We and you should all take the good and evil of former ages as encouragement.

sentences.zh: 朕或思有未至，卿等其言之。」

translations.literal: If We think of something not yet reached, you should speak of it."
translations.idiomatic: If We think of something not yet reached, you should speak of it."

sentences.zh: 阿鲁图顿首舞蹈而出。

translations.literal: Alutu bowed his head, danced, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Alutu bowed his head, danced, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 右司郎中陈思谦建言诸事，阿鲁图曰：「左右司之职所以赞助宰相。

translations.literal: Right Secretariat Director Chen Siqian proposed various matters; Alutu said: "The duty of the left and right directorates is to assist the chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Right Secretariat Director Chen Siqian proposed various matters. Alutu said, "The duty of the left and right directorates is to assist the chief minister.

sentences.zh: 今郎中有所言，与我辈共议见诸行事，何必别为文字自有所陈耶？

translations.literal: If the director now has something to say, let him discuss it with us and see it carried out in affairs—why must he separately make writings and present matters on his own?
translations.idiomatic: If the director now has something to say, let him discuss it with us and see it carried out—why must he separately make writings and present matters on his own?

sentences.zh: 郎中若居他官，则可建言，今居左右司而建言，是徒欲显一己自能言耳。

translations.literal: If the director held another office, he could propose; now holding the left or right directorate yet proposing is merely wishing to show that he alone can speak.
translations.idiomatic: If the director held another office he could propose; now holding the left or right directorate yet proposing is merely wishing to show that he alone can speak.

sentences.zh: 将置我辈于何地？」

translations.literal: Where are you placing us?"
translations.idiomatic: Where are you placing us?"

sentences.zh: 思谦大惭服。

translations.literal: Siqian was greatly ashamed and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Siqian was greatly ashamed and submitted.

sentences.zh: 一日，与僚佐议除刑部尚书，宰执有所举，或难之曰：「此人柔软，非刑部所可用。」

translations.literal: One day, discussing with subordinates the appointment of minister of justice, the chief ministers had someone to recommend; some made difficulties, saying: "This man is soft—not usable by the Ministry of Justice."
translations.idiomatic: One day, discussing with subordinates the appointment of minister of justice, the chief ministers had someone to recommend. Some objected, saying, "This man is soft—not usable by the Ministry of Justice."

sentences.zh: 阿鲁图曰：「庙堂即今选侩子耶？

translations.literal: Alutu said: "Is the imperial temple selecting wrestlers today?
translations.idiomatic: Alutu said, "Is the imperial temple selecting wrestlers today?

sentences.zh: 若选侩子，须选强壮人。

translations.literal: If selecting wrestlers, one must select strong men.
translations.idiomatic: If selecting wrestlers, one must select strong men.

sentences.zh: 尚书欲其详谳刑牍耳，若不枉人，不坏法，即是好刑官，何必求强壮人耶？」

translations.literal: The minister of justice wishes only to examine criminal documents in detail; if he does not wrong people and does not break the law, he is a good justice official—why must one seek a strong man?"
translations.idiomatic: The minister of justice wishes only to examine criminal documents in detail. If he does not wrong people and does not break the law, he is a good justice official—why seek a strong man?"

sentences.zh: 左右无以答。

translations.literal: Those at left and right had no answer.
translations.idiomatic: Those at left and right had no answer.

sentences.zh: 其为治知大体，类如此。

translations.literal: In governing he knew the larger pattern, generally like this.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he knew the larger pattern, generally like this.

sentences.zh: 先是，别兒怯不花尝与阿鲁图谋挤害脱脱。

translations.literal: Earlier Bieqiebuha had once plotted with Alutu to squeeze out and harm Toghto.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Bieqiebuha had once plotted with Alutu to squeeze out and harm Toghto.

sentences.zh: 阿鲁图曰：「我等岂能久居相位，当亦有退休之日，人将谓我何？」

translations.literal: Alutu said: "How can we long hold the chancellorship? There will also be a day of retirement—what will people say of us?"
translations.idiomatic: Alutu said, "How can we long hold the chancellorship? There will also be a day of retirement—what will people say of us?"

sentences.zh: 别兒怯不花屡以为言，终不从。

translations.literal: Bieqiebuha repeatedly spoke of it but in the end he would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Bieqiebuha repeatedly spoke of it but in the end Alutu would not follow.

sentences.zh: 六年，别兒怯不花乃讽监察御史劾奏阿鲁图不宜居相位，阿鲁图即避出城。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Bieqiebuha therefore prompted investigating censors to memorialize and impeach that Alutu ought not to hold the chancellorship; Alutu at once withdrew outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Bieqiebuha prompted investigating censors to memorialize that Alutu ought not to hold the chancellorship; Alutu at once withdrew outside the city.

sentences.zh: 其姻党皆为之不平，请曰：「丞相所行皆善，而御史言者无理，丞相何不见帝自陈，帝必辩焉。」

translations.literal: His affines were all indignant on his behalf and requested: "What the chief minister has done is all good, yet the censor's words are unreasonable—the chief minister ought to see the emperor and explain himself; the emperor will surely argue on his behalf."
translations.idiomatic: His affines were indignant and said, "What the chief minister has done is all good, yet the censor's words are unreasonable. The chief minister ought to see the emperor and explain himself; the emperor will surely argue on his behalf."

sentences.zh: 阿鲁图曰：「我博尔术世裔，岂丞相为难得耶？

translations.literal: Alutu said: "I am a Borokhula descendant of generations—how could the chancellorship be hard to obtain?
translations.idiomatic: Alutu said, "I am a Borokhula descendant of generations—how could the chancellorship be hard to obtain?

sentences.zh: 但帝命我不敢辞，今御史劾我，我宜即去。

translations.literal: But the emperor's command I dared not decline; now the censor impeaches me—I ought to leave at once.
translations.idiomatic: But the emperor's command I dared not decline; now the censor impeaches me—I ought to leave at once.

sentences.zh: 盖御史臺乃世祖所设置，我若与御史抗，即与世祖抗矣。

translations.literal: The Censorate was established by Shizu; if I contend with the censor, I contend with Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate was established by Shizu; if I contend with the censor, I contend with Shizu.

sentences.zh: 尔等无复言。

translations.literal: You need speak no more.
translations.idiomatic: You need speak no more.

sentences.zh: 「阿鲁图既罢去，明年，别兒怯不花遂为右丞相，不久亦去。

translations.literal: After Alutu had been dismissed, the next year Bieqiebuha became right chief councilor and before long also left.
translations.idiomatic: After Alutu had been dismissed, the next year Bieqiebuha became right chief councilor and before long also left.

sentences.zh: 十一年，阿鲁图复起为太傅，出守和林边，薨，无嗣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Alutu was again raised as Grand Preceptor, went out to guard the Helin frontier, died, and had no heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Alutu was again raised as grand preceptor, went out to guard the Helin frontier, died, and had no heir.

sentences.zh: 纽的该

translations.literal: Niudegai
translations.idiomatic: Niudegai

sentences.zh: 纽的该，博尔术之四世孙也。

translations.literal: Niudegai was also a fourth-generation descendant of Borokhula.
translations.idiomatic: Niudegai was also a fourth-generation descendant of Borokhula.

sentences.zh: 早岁备宿卫，累迁同知枢密院事，既而废处于家。

translations.literal: In early years he served in the palace guard and was repeatedly promoted to associate director of the Privy Council; afterward he was dismissed and dwelt at home.
translations.idiomatic: In early years he served in the palace guard and was repeatedly promoted to associate director of the privy council; afterward he was dismissed and dwelt at home.

sentences.zh: 顺帝至元五年，奉使宣抚达达之地，整理有司不公不法事三十餘条，由是朝廷知其才，升知岭北行枢密院事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan under Emperor Shundi he was sent as commissioner to pacify and comfort the Tatar lands, put in order more than thirty matters of unfair and unlawful conduct by officials, and thereby the court knew his talent and promoted him to direct the Lingbei Branch Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan under Emperor Shundi he was sent to pacify and comfort the Tatar lands, put in order more than thirty matters of unfair and unlawful conduct by officials, and the court knew his talent and promoted him to direct the Lingbei Branch Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 至正十五年，召拜中书平章政事，迁知枢密院事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhizheng he was summoned and appointed pacification commissioner of the Secretariat and transferred to know the affairs of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Zhizheng he was summoned and appointed pacification commissioner of the Secretariat and transferred to know the affairs of the privy council.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以太尉总山东诸军，守镇东昌路，击退田丰兵。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, as Grand Preceptor he commanded all armies of Shandong, guarded and held Dongchang Circuit, and repelled Tian Feng's troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, as grand preceptor he commanded all armies of Shandong, guarded Dongchang Circuit, and repelled Tian Feng's troops.

sentences.zh: 十八年，田丰复陷济宁，进逼东昌。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Tian Feng again took Jining and pressed toward Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Tian Feng again took Jining and pressed toward Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 纽的该以乏粮弃城，退屯柏乡，东昌遂陷。

translations.literal: Niudegai, lacking grain, abandoned the city, withdrew to garrison at Baixiang, and Dongchang then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Niudegai, lacking grain, abandoned the city, withdrew to garrison at Baixiang, and Dongchang then fell.

sentences.zh: 还京师，拜中书添设左丞相，与太平同居相位。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital he was appointed additional left chief councilor of the Secretariat and together with Taiping jointly held the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the capital he was appointed additional left chief councilor of the Secretariat and together with Taiping jointly held the chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 纽的该有识量，处事平允。

translations.literal: Niudegai had discernment and judgment and handled affairs fairly.
translations.idiomatic: Niudegai had discernment and judgment and handled affairs fairly.

sentences.zh: 倭人攻金复州，杀红军据其州者，即奏遣人往赏赉而抚安之。

translations.literal: When Japanese attacked Jinzhou and killed the Red Army men who held the prefecture, he at once memorialized to send men to bestow rewards and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: When Japanese attacked Jinzhou and killed the Red Army men who held the prefecture, he memorialized to send men to bestow rewards and comfort them.

sentences.zh: 浙西张士诚既降，纽的该处置江南诸事，咸得其宜，士诚大服。

translations.literal: After Zhang Shicheng of Jiangxi had submitted, Niudegai disposed of all matters in the south of the Yangtze and all obtained their fitness; Shicheng was greatly impressed.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Shicheng of Jiangxi had submitted, Niudegai disposed of all matters south of the Yangtze fittingly; Shicheng was greatly impressed.

sentences.zh: 兴和路富民调戏子妇，系狱，车载楮币至京师行赂，以故刑部官持其事久不决。

translations.literal: A wealthy man of Xinghe Circuit molested his daughter-in-law and was imprisoned; he loaded paper money onto a cart and came to the capital to bribe—therefore Ministry of Justice officials held the matter long undecided.
translations.idiomatic: A wealthy man of Xinghe Circuit molested his daughter-in-law and was imprisoned. He loaded paper money onto a cart and came to the capital to bribe, so Ministry of Justice officials held the matter long undecided.

sentences.zh: 纽的该乃除刑部侍郎为兴和路达鲁花赤，俾决其事，富民遂自缢死。

translations.literal: Niudegai then removed a vice minister of justice to be darughachi of Xinghe Circuit and ordered him to decide the matter; the wealthy man thereupon hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Niudegai then removed a vice minister of justice to be darughachi of Xinghe Circuit and ordered him to decide the matter; the wealthy man thereupon hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 凡授官，惟才是选，不用私人，众称其有大臣体。

translations.literal: Whenever he granted office he selected only by talent and used no private persons; the multitude praised that he had the bearing of a great minister.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he granted office he selected only by talent and used no private persons; all praised that he had the bearing of a great minister.

sentences.zh: 已而遽罢相，迁知枢密院事。

translations.literal: Before long he was abruptly dismissed from the chancellorship and transferred to know the affairs of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was abruptly dismissed from the chancellorship and transferred to know the affairs of the privy council.

sentences.zh: 尝卧病，谓其所知曰：「太平真宰相才也。

translations.literal: Once when ill in bed he said to those he knew: "Taiping is truly a chief minister's talent.
translations.idiomatic: Once when ill in bed he said to those he knew, "Taiping is truly a chief minister's talent.

sentences.zh: 我疾固不起，而太平亦不能久于位，此可叹也。」

translations.literal: My illness surely will not rise, yet Taiping also cannot long hold his post—this is lamentable."
translations.idiomatic: My illness surely will not rise, yet Taiping also cannot long hold his post—this is lamentable."

sentences.zh: 朝官至门候疾者，皆谢遣之。

translations.literal: Court officials who came to the door to inquire after his illness were all sent away with thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials who came to the door to inquire after his illness were all sent away with thanks.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月卒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year he died.
